items.q: Do I need a reservation for dinner?
items.a: Reservations are recommended on Friday and Saturday evenings. Walk-ins are always welcome for lunch and weekday dinners.
Absolutely. We offer full-service catering for up to 200 guests. Contact us at least two weeks in advance to plan your event.

items.q: Is there a vegetarian or vegan menu?
items.a: Yes — we have a dedicated selection of vegetarian pizzas and can adapt most dishes to be vegan. Just ask your server.
For groups of eight or more, please let us know 24 hours in advance. For smaller parties, same-day cancellations are fine.
We offer a certified gluten-free dough. Please note our kitchen is not entirely gluten-free, so tell us about any allergies.
